title: Evaluation atoms for research and agent harnesses
description: Small, exact, standard-library Python implementations of two kinds of component. The first kind is the statistics a research harness needs to compare learning systems: diversity and calibration measures, paired and multiple-comparison tests, anytime-valid and conformal intervals, overfitting corrections, fusion rules and data-split constructions. The second kind is the bounded-work contracts an agent harness needs: typed work results, conserved budget ledgers, coverage ledgers, applicability certificates, staleness and revocation graphs, idempotent effects and evidence states, each as a validator or a small ledger with a JSON Schema where the contract is a document. Every item is an importable module with input validation and a JSON command line. Its contract card lists the entry points, the assumptions, the guarantees, the known answers its tests reproduce and at least one known-wrong case its tests must refuse. Packages carry the shared helpers numerics.py, atom_cli.py and schema_lite.py and the shared test_package.py; nothing needs an engine, a network or a third-party package.

engine.name: python
engine.notes: Standard library only; tested with Python 3.10 and 3.14
